stale_scope.scope_rule: query -> metric -> evidence references and migration source pairs

replay.median_rule: odd: middle; even: round-half-up integer mean

rules.insufficient: source A or B has fewer than min_evidence unique observations for a metric
rules.migratable: both conclusions have the same slow status and every metric delta <= tolerance
rules.not_migratable: slow status differs, or at least one metric delta > tolerance
rules.value_tolerance_pct: absolute normalized metric delta / max(value_a, value_b)
